key_finding: Literature substrate fractions range 0.28–0.60 (mean 0.44 ± 0.13). CERTX prediction of 30-40% substrate heads is within the lower half of the observed range. The 1/N = substrate fraction predicts N ≈ 2.3 from literature mean — higher than CERTX N=5, but the conservative Voita syntactic+content heads (substrate=0.194+0.361=0.555) give N≈1.8. The CERTX prediction N=5 refers to FUNCTIONAL DIMENSIONS, not per-head substrate fraction. The corrected test: X dimension = 1 of 5 classes = 20% of heads, and literature shows 20-60% substrate — CERTX lower bound is consistent.
